An & that would read as a character reference in a link destination or title stays literal

```python title="Python"
from html_to_markdown import convert

def main() -> None:
    html = '<a href="?&amp;plus;" title="&amp;plus;">T</a>'
    result = convert(html)
    print(result.content)

main()
```
